shared_elements: human head with frontal facial features (eyes, nose, mouth)
justification: The only shared depicted content is the generic presence of anthropomorphic figures with rendered faces and arms, stacked one above another on a vertical surface. Everything specific differs: A is a massively schematic three-dimensional column of a grinning toothed head over a broad staring face with stubby arms, while B is a shallow relief scene with slender, richly patterned garmented figures, a winged attendant, a plant/tree motif and a band of dense script above, organised in horizontal registers — no shared motif, attribute or relationship at all.
